home.title: MigraAid
home.metaDescription: Multilingual rights and support hub for migrant workers in Singapore.
home.tagline: Understand your rights in Singapore — in your language.
home.heroLede: Answers about pay, permits, housing and healthcare, grounded in Singapore law and verified with NGO caseworkers.
home.cardLawBody: Every answer cites the Employment Act, WICA, or MOM guidelines it comes from.
home.cardPrivacyBody: No login, no name. Contract photos are analysed, never stored.
home.disclaimer: MigraAid gives general information, not legal advice. For your specific situation, contact a caseworker at a partner organisation. In an emergency, use the Emergency Contacts page.

chat.title: Ask MigraAid
chat.empty: Ask about your rights, pay, housing, healthcare, or paperwork.
chat.escalatedNotice: This looks serious. Please contact a caseworker at a partner organisation.
chat.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.feedbackError: We could not save your feedback. Please try again.
chat.referralCodeHelp: Give this private handoff code to the organisation after you contact them. It expires on {date}.
chat.referralCodeHelpNoDate: Give this private handoff code to the organisation after you contact them. It expires in 30 days.
chat.privacy: Do not include names, ID or passport numbers, phone numbers, or email addresses. Your question is sent to an AI provider. Where possible, MigraAid removes common identifiers before sending or storing it.

emergency.title: Emergency contacts
emergency.intro: If you are in danger, call 999 (Police) or 995 (Ambulance/Fire) now.
emergency.verifyNote: Please confirm these numbers are current before relying on them.

policeSms.name: Police emergency SMS
policeSms.note: If it is unsafe to speak or you cannot speak

contract.title: Explain my contract
contract.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP · up to 8 MB
contract.privacy: Your photo is securely sent to an AI provider for analysis. MigraAid does not store the photo or extracted contract text. The AI provider may retain safety logs for up to 30 days.
contract.saveAnalysis: Save the derived analysis for up to 30 days. MigraAid stores only the summary, key terms, and flagged points—not your photo or extracted contract text. You can delete the saved analysis later from this device.
contract.savedConfirmation: Your summary, key terms, and flagged points were saved for up to 30 days. Your photo and extracted contract text were not saved.
contract.saveFailed: Your analysis is shown below, but it could not be saved. Your photo and extracted contract text were not stored. You can try again later.
contract.error: Sorry, we couldn't read that. Please try a clearer photo.
contract.errorInvalidFile: Choose a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image of your contract.
contract.errorTooLarge: That image is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller image and try again.
contract.errorRateLimited: Too many contract checks were requested. Please wait a minute and try again.
contract.noFlags: The automated check did not identify a specific concerning clause in this image.
contract.analysisCaveat: This automated explanation may miss details and is not legal advice. Check important terms with a caseworker before you agree or sign.

privacy.confirm: Delete the saved conversations and contract analyses linked to this device? This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleted: Your MigraAid data has been deleted.
privacy.error: We could not delete your data. Please try again.
